buildathon_debt.definition: A buildathon submission is an entry of subjects.buildathon.submissions: a project on the public list of the Reactive Omni Buildathon, with the contracts on the reactive chain that its public repository names. A submission is in debt if debt(contract) on the ledger is above zero at to for one of these contracts or more. A contract that a repository names can be an old deployment.

cron_poller_ward_dead_time.definition: The dead time is the longest debt interval of the ward in from..to: from BlacklistContract(ward), or from `from` if the debt was open then, to the next WhitelistContract(ward), or to `to`.

cron_stopped_share.definition: Among the contracts with a Subscribe log on Lasna in from..to, a contract is cron-subscribed if one of these logs has a cron topic (Cron1 to Cron10000) as topic0, and a contract is stopped if debt(contract) is above zero at to.

destination_debt_events.definition: A debt event is a BlacklistContract log of the callback proxy of a configured destination chain in from..to.

dropped_callbacks.definition: A CallbackRequest log on Lasna is counted as dropped if, at the block timestamp of the request, its recipient has an open debt interval on the destination proxy (from BlacklistContract(recipient) to the next WhitelistContract(recipient), or to `to`); the number is derived from debt intervals and the proxy rule (InDebt), not from observed reverted transactions, and a request within the latency margin of an interval edge, or of the end of the destination window, is counted as uncertain.

result.derivation: Derived from debt intervals on the destination proxy and the proxy rule (InDebt). It is not a count of observed reverted transactions.
result.limit: An interval that opened before `from` and did not close in the range is not visible. A request at or after the `to` timestamp of the destination chain minus the margin, to a recipient whose interval is open at `to`, is counted as uncertain.

fastfill_fill_times.definition: A fill is a fill log whose join field is equal to the join field of a deposit log in from..to; its time is the fill block timestamp minus the deposit block timestamp, and the 90th percentile is the nearest-rank value.

fastfill_reactive_reserves.definition: The value is reserves(FastfillReactive) on the ledger of its chain at to.

guest_candidates.definition: A guest candidate is a contract seen in the scan (a debtor, a subscriber on Lasna, or a callback recipient on a destination chain) that has a debt event in from..to, has debt above zero at to, or holds reserves below a few runs of the sample fee at to.

result.sampleFeeNote: The sample fees are samples, not protocol constants (specification F8).

lasna_debt_events.definition: A debt event is a BlacklistContract log of the Lasna system contract in from..to; the ledger emits it only when a debt goes from zero to positive.

repeat_debtors.definition: A repeat debtor is a contract with 3 or more debt events on one chain in from..to.

stopped_contracts.definition: A contract is stopped if its ledger emitted BlacklistContract for it in from..to and debt(contract) is above zero at to; the cohort is each contract with a debt event in from..to.
